title: Kiln VFX blocks: the "vfx" section of blocks/*.json
description: Effects written from nothing: particles, a light. The same shape as the C# records. No compiler, no game data.

section.description: Effects by name. Each becomes one VFX with an id from your mod id and its name.

name.description: The block's name. Ids come from your mod id and this: keep it. A rename says "was".

block.description: One effect. It needs particles, a light, or both.

particles.description: What spawns and how it looks. At most 27 with a light, 27 without (each takes two of a VFX's 55 entries).

sound.description: A sound's name. Not played yet: counted in the budget of 10 new sounds in VFX.

cullDistance.description: Metres. Beyond this nothing is simulated or drawn. A number is the far distance; [near, far] gives both. Default [50, 75].

was.description: The block's old name: the id stays the old one, so nothing that names this effect notices the rename.

gameSpriteModule.description: A diagnostic: draw the particles with one of the game's own sprite modules, to tell a problem in the data from one in Kiln's module. It takes the first colour and size, the texture and the mesh; the rest is baked into that module.

particle.description: A particle emitter. It needs a burst or a rate.

burst.description: Particles at the start, and at each loop.

rate.description: Particles per second. At most 64 spawn per tick.

duration.description: Seconds of emission. Without it a rate runs until the effect is stopped; a burst alone needs none.

loop.description: Start again after the duration, which must be above 0.

maxCount.description: Particles alive at once. Derived when left out. The game reads it on the CPU, where the shaders can't enforce it, so it stops at 4096.

lifetime.description: Seconds a particle lives: a number or [min, max]. Default 1.

speed.description: Metres per second at spawn: a number or [min, max]. Default 1.

spread.description: Direction at spawn, around the effect's up. outward: away from the centre of the shape. Default up.

spawnRadius.description: Metres: start inside a sphere this big. Default 0, at the effect's position. The same as shape {"sphere": r}: say one or the other.

shape.description: Where particles start, in the effect's space (its scale and rotation apply). Sizes in metres. Default: the effect's position.

sphere.description: Inside a sphere of this radius.

hemisphere.description: Inside the upper half of a sphere.

box.description: Inside a box this big, centred.

disc.description: On a flat disc in the effect's horizontal plane.

ring.description: On a circle in the effect's horizontal plane.

line.description: On a line this long along the effect's x, centred.

align.description: velocity: a camera-facing quad turns to point the way it moves (sparks, rain, streaks). Default camera.

stretch.description: With align velocity: extra length in metres per metre per second of speed.

shader.description: Advanced: this mod's own particle module, a .spv built with kiln-vfxcook shader build (docs/kiln/modding/shaders.md). Needs "advanced": true in kiln.mod.json. If it can't be used, Kiln's own sprite draws the particle.

constants.description: Up to 8 numbers the module reads as c.user0 and c.user1.

gravity.description: Metres per second squared on world y: negative falls.

acceleration.description: Metres per second squared in world space, added to gravity.

spin.description: Degrees per second: a number or [min, max].

roll.description: Degrees at spawn: a number or [min, max].

size.description: Metres over the particle's life. Default 0.25. Above 64 is clamped.

alpha.description: 0 to 1 over the particle's life. Default 1.

color.description: sRGB over the particle's life. Default white.

intensity.description: Multiplies the colour, which may then exceed 1. Default 1.

texture.description: A PNG in your mod, power of two on both sides, 4 to 2048. Without one the particle is white.

linear.description: The image holds data, not colour: no sRGB. Default false.

sampler.description: How the texture repeats. Default wrap.

flipbook.description: The texture is a grid of frames.

fps.description: Frames per second. Without it the grid plays once over the particle's life.

lit.description: Take ambient and sun light through the fog volume. Default false.

mesh.description: quad faces the camera; quad-xz lies flat. Default quad.

faceCamera.description: Turn the mesh to the camera. Default: true for quad, false for others.

depthFade.description: Metres of soft fade against the scene.

emissive.description: How much the colour follows the camera's exposure correction.

material.description: A material of this mod: its albedo as the texture, its tint in the colour, and lit, as far as the particle says nothing itself. A sprite draws with the game's transparent shaders, so the rest of a material doesn't apply.

materialSection.description: Surfaces for models, by name. Each becomes one material with an id from your mod id and its name. Name one in a model step of assets/cook.json.

materialPng.description: Relative to your mod's folder. A power of two on both sides, 4 to 4096.

material.description: A surface on the game's own shaders. Everything has a default: a material with no maps at all is a flat colour.

kind.description: What it is, and where every other field starts from. Default opaque. metal: metallic 1, roughness 0.35. cutout: holes where alpha is under 0.5. foliage: cutout, double sided, light comes through. cloth: double sided, rough. emissive: glows, strength 4. dithered: soft edges from a dither pattern.

albedo.description: Colour, sRGB. Its alpha is what a cutout cuts by.

tint.description: sRGB. Multiplies the albedo; without one it is the colour. Built into the texture: the game's block has no tint of its own.

normal.description: A tangent-space normal map, green up as in glTF and Blender.

yDown.description: Green points down, as in DirectX maps.

params.description: The game's own layout, linear: R metallic, G roughness, B occlusion, A reflectance if reflectance says "params".

metallicRoughness.description: glTF's layout, linear: G roughness, B metallic.

roughness.description: The value without a map, a factor with one. Default by kind, 0.7 for opaque.

metallic.description: The value without a map, a factor with one. Default by kind, 0 for opaque.

reflectance.description: Non-metal specular, a number. "params" reads it from the alpha of the params map. Default 0.503, what nearly all of the game's materials use.

emissive.description: What glows: a PNG, a colour, or both with a strength.

color.description: sRGB. Multiplies the map; without one it is the colour.

exposure.description: How much it follows the camera's exposure correction. Default 0.75.

alphaTest.description: Cut where the albedo's alpha is under this. true is 0.5. The game's shaders cut at 0.5, so another value rescales the alpha.

doubleSided.description: Draw both faces, with the normal turned on the back.

frost.description: Takes frost in the cold. Default true.

wetness.description: Darkens in the rain. Default true.

vertexColor.description: Multiply the albedo by the model's vertex colour.

translucent.description: How much light comes through from behind. Default 0, 1 for kind foliage.

dissolve.description: The game can fade it in and out with an edge glow, as it does to creatures and placed objects.

noiseBlend.description: Noise against distance from the centre. Default 0.3.

uvScale.description: Repeats of every map: a number, or [u, v]. Default 1.

shader.description: Reserved for surface shaders, which aren't built yet: Kiln refuses a material that names one.

was.description: The block's old name: the id stays the old one, so a model that names it doesn't notice the rename.

replaces.description: The GUID of one of the game's materials: this block draws in its place on every model that uses it (items, props, creatures). Keep its kind: the models carry the original's cutout and double-sided flags. Client-side only; a mod that only replaces may be side client.

light.description: One point light for the life of the effect.

lifetime.description: Seconds. Default 0: until the effect is stopped.

fadeOut.description: Seconds, at the end of the lifetime or after the effect stops.

curve.description: A number; {"linear": [start, end]}; a list of evenly spaced values; or {"keys": [[t, value], ...]}. Sampled to 8 values.

gradient.description: One colour; a list of evenly spaced colours; or {"keys": [[t, "#rrggbb"], ...]}.
